exit 0
--- stdout
Attribute provider token usage to the outcome each task reached.
The report shows, per outcome class and role, the total, median and p95 fresh,
cache-read and output tokens; cache-read tokens per merged task with the
cache-hit percentage; tokens spent after each task's last useful transition,
by role and failure category; provenance counts for unknown, partial and
conflicting records; and the lifecycle counter rows that show suppressed
duplicate and preflight-rejected calls. An unavailable store or counter file
is reported as a warning, never as zero.
A breakdown (--by, default model) groups authoritative usage by model, role,
agent, task or provider: fresh input, cache write (with its 1h part), cache
read, output and reasoning tokens, the cache-hit percentage over all input,
and the provider-reported cost with a count of unpriced records. By model, a
turn that used several models (subagents, background models) contributes one
share to each.
The window defaults to the current sprint: from its start until it ended, or
now. Time bounds accept RFC 3339 timestamps or YYYY-MM-DD dates (UTC).
--as-of reads task outcomes as they stood at that point, so a reading can be
reproduced after later reconciliation. A baseline window renders a second
report over the same records and the deltas between the two.
Examples:
liza usage report --json
liza usage report --since 2026-09-07 --until 2026-09-10 --role coder
liza usage report --by role
liza usage report --task task-1 --as-of <TIME> --format yaml
liza usage report --baseline-since 2026-09-01 --baseline-until 2026-09-06 --json
Usage:
liza usage report [flags]
Flags:
--as-of string read task outcomes as of this time; defaults to --until
--baseline-since string baseline window start for a before/after comparison
--baseline-until string baseline window end for a before/after comparison
--by string breakdown dimension: model, role, agent, task, or provider (default "model")
--format string output format: json, yaml, table, or value (default "table")
-h, --help help for report
--json output result as structured JSON
--role string only records of this role
--since string window start (RFC 3339 or YYYY-MM-DD); defaults to the sprint start
--task string only records of this task
--until string window end (RFC 3339 or YYYY-MM-DD); defaults to the sprint end or now
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
